page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with the running head at the top. Page number at top left. "FINIS." centred below the text, then a woodcut fleuron (not text). Catchword at bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Ibidem.pag.112. DEus in nobis efficit,ut,nisi sponte nobis desimus,praecepta ipsius, per hanc ejusdem gratiam ,praestare & possimus & velimus,adeoque reipsa praestemus:ita saltem ut DEus in hac praestatione clementer acquiescat.

A VENATORE, Declar.pag.174. Non credo DEum jure posse ab hominibus exigere, quod à nativitate ipsa praestare non potuerunt : atque ad hoc praestandum vires dare non velle, & quod tamen propterea velit eos condemnare, quod bonum impossibile non praestiterint, & peccatum inevitabile non omiserint.
Ibidem.pag.177. Nullo modo assentiri possum DEum ab homine exigere quod praestare non possit, & ad quod praestandum vires non conferat , neque unquam conferre ve-lit.

page.notes: Woodcut fleuron below FINIS, not transcribed. Show-through from the reverse side is visible faintly in the left and centre; ignored. Some words are uncertain in the small type: "possimus" and "praestare" could be misread at this resolution, and "praestemus" may be read differently. "DEVS"/"DEVM" printed in small capitals with v for u; given as DEus/DEum per rule 5. The catchword "HARMO-" is at the foot right and is taken as the catchword.
